remarks: Welcome to 21513 Craig Court, a spacious single-family home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in Carson! Offering approximately 1,956 square feet of living space, this home features a versatile floor plan with generously sized living areas, a formal dining room, and a functional kitchen with granite countertops. The home offers a flexible layout with a main-floor bedroom, making it ideal for guests, extended family, or a home office. Additional features include a two-car attached garage, indoor laundry area, and a covered patio overlooking the backyard—perfect for relaxing or entertaining.
